lines.text: Mara's lab. Officially 'Scale-State Instrumentation'. Unofficially, where the coffee lives.
You're wondering about Dexter. Everyone does, eventually.
Half the Gate math came off one whiteboard we shared. We could argue for hours and still solve the problem afterward.
I know he isn't pretending to care about humanity. That's what frightens me.
You came back. Both of them came back. On a first descent, that's the whole score.
The Thoughtstone readings from your field log are... wrong. Not broken. Wrong in a very consistent direction.
Curiosity always wins. It just usually costs more than people expect.
